lines.text: The LORD calls the islands to be silent, and says He is the first and the last.
The islands see and fear, and the craftsman encourages the goldsmith, who nails the welding down.
The LORD calls Israel His servant, a descendant of Abraham His shepherd, and tells them not to fear.
The LORD makes Israel a new, sharp threshing sledge to crush the mountains, and Israel will rejoice in Egypt.
The LORD will open rivers on the barren heights and plant cedars in the wilderness so all will know He did it.
